name: Swift Shapeshifter [Psionic]
body:
You are naturally confident with different shapes and forms, and years of training have allowed your body to more easily flow into new shapes.

Prerequisites: Ability to manifest metamorphosis

Benefit: When you manifest minor metamorphosis, major metamorphosis or metamorphosis the manifestation time is a move action instead of a standard action.
